# whatson.movie

> Cinema listings for Valencia, Barcelona, Alicante and Málaga, Spain. Covers every film showing across all major cinemas in each city, with VOSE (versión original subtitulada — original language with Spanish subtitles) screenings clearly identified. Updated daily. Free weekly email every Thursday.

whatson.movie is an independent listings site aimed at English speakers and film fans in Valencia, Barcelona, Alicante and Málaga who want to watch films in their original language. VOSE screenings are highlighted throughout. Data is scraped fresh each morning and covers the next 7 days of showtimes.

## Listings pages

- [Valencia cinema listings](https://whatson.movie/listings/valencia/): All films showing in Valencia this week, with showtimes by cinema. VOSE screenings highlighted. Filterable by cinema, VOSE-only, new releases, and more.
- [Barcelona cinema listings](https://whatson.movie/listings/barcelona/): All films showing in Barcelona this week, same format.
- [Alicante cinema listings](https://whatson.movie/listings/alicante/): All films showing in Alicante and nearby (San Vicente, San Juan, Elche) this week, same format.
- [Málaga cinema listings](https://whatson.movie/listings/malaga/): All films showing in Málaga and nearby (Rincón de la Victoria, Vélez-Málaga, Fuengirola, Marbella) this week, same format.
- English versions (same listings, English titles and synopses): [all cities](https://whatson.movie/en/listings/), [Valencia](https://whatson.movie/en/listings/valencia/), [Barcelona](https://whatson.movie/en/listings/barcelona/), [Alicante](https://whatson.movie/en/listings/alicante/), [Málaga](https://whatson.movie/en/listings/malaga/).
- [Film detail pages](https://whatson.movie/listings/): Each film has its own page at /listings/{slug}/ with full showtimes across all cinemas, film metadata (year, country, duration, genre), synopsis, and trailer link.

## Cinemas covered

**Valencia:** Kinépolis Valencia, Yelmo Campanar, Cinesa LUXE Bonaire, Ocine Premium Aqua, Cines ABC Park, Cines ABC El Saler, Cines ABC Gran Turia, Cines Lys, Cines MN4, Cine Tívoli, Cines Babel, Cinestudio D'Or.

**Barcelona:** Cines Verdi, Renoir Floridablanca, Aribau Multicines, Cinesa Diagonal, Cinesa Diagonal Mar, Yelmo La Maquinista, Mooby Glòries, Mooby Arenas, Ocine Màgic Badalona.

**Alicante:** Kinépolis Alicante, Yelmo Puerta de Alicante, Odeon Multicines Alicante, Cines ABC Elx, Cines Aana Alicante, Cines Aana San Juan.

**Málaga:** Yelmo Vialia Málaga, Yelmo Plaza Mayor, Multicines Rosaleda, Cine Albéniz, Yelmo Rincón de la Victoria, mk2 El Ingenio (Vélez-Málaga), mk2 Miramar (Fuengirola), Kinépolis La Cañada (Marbella).

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Last updated: 2026-11-18 (showtimes are re-checked every morning; this date is set by each run)
- VOSE means the film is shown in its original language with Spanish subtitles (not dubbed). VOSE covers every original language (English, Japanese, French…), not only English.
- VOSE is marked per session, only when the cinema says so for that session. A session the cinema doesn't label is treated as dubbed, so the VOSE listings may miss a session but should never wrongly claim one.
- Some Spanish-language films have sessions with English subtitles (cinemas call these VOSI or "V.O. subt. inglés"). They are tagged "EN SUBS" and are never counted as VOSE.
- Each city page opens with a one-line summary of the week (films, cinemas, VOSE films), and the home page has an FAQ with this week's VOSE numbers per city.
- Showtimes cover the next 7 days from the date of the last daily update.
- The site does not cover every cinema in Spain — only the cities listed above.
- Weekly subscriber email sent every Thursday evening summarising VOSE and new releases.
- Data source: individual cinema websites and APIs, aggregated daily.
